description: What changed in Swiss federal law in a date range (Classified Compilation): 'amended' = acts for which a new consolidated version became applicable (amendments taking effect, incl. new acts), 'entered_into_force' = acts that entered into force, 'repealed' = acts that ceased to be in force. Returns date, SR number, title and Fedlex link, newest first. Dates may lie in the future to see scheduled changes. Examples: {} (amendments in the last 30 days); {change:'entered_into_force', date_from:'2025-01-01', date_to:'2025-01-31'}; {sr_prefix:'8', query:'Kranken'} (health law).

query.description: Optional title keyword in the chosen language

sr_prefix.description: Restrict to an SR area, e.g. '2' (private law), '6' (finance/tax), '8' (health/labour), '0.' (treaties)

name: list_recent_legislation_changes
title: Recent changes to federal legislation
